overview: The Medford City Council reviewed recommendations from a recent public safety summit, questioned municipal transfers and deficits in school facility accounts, and approved holding monthly police community meetings across the city's four sectors.

items.title: Report on Committee of the Whole Public Safety Summit
items.summary: The Council received a report from the May 18 public safety summit regarding police staffing levels, traffic calming, and facility security, and observed a moment of silence for slain Auburn Police Officer Ronald Tarantino Jr.

items.title: Resolution on Pedestrian and Neighborhood Safety Concerns
items.summary: The Council discussed resident feedback regarding pedestrian safety, traffic calming, sidewalk repairs, and neighborhood police presence before placing the resolution on file.

items.title: Inquiry on Edgerly Field Debt Transfers and Facility Accounts
items.summary: The Council passed an amended resolution requesting details from the administration regarding $100,000 transferred to cover Edgerly Field debt, as well as financial updates on LoConte Rink, the high school pool, and Community Schools.

items.title: Police Department Neighborhood Community Meetings
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting that the police department hold its monthly community meetings rotating through each of the city's four sectors starting in September.

items.title: Commendation for John Jack Buckley
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating John "Jack" Buckley on his retirement after years of service on the School Committee, in the DPW, and as chair of the Hormel Commission.

items.title: Presentation on Founding Fathers and Medford Governance
items.summary: Dr. John Storella addressed the Council on constitutional principles, term limits, and civic governance, after which the presentation was placed on file.

items.title: Formal Approval of Committee of the Whole Report
items.summary: The Council formally voted to approve the May 18 Committee of the Whole report on public safety.

items.title: Business Under Suspension of the Rules
items.summary: Under suspension of the rules, the Council requested DCR pothole repairs on Route 16, asked for estimates to upgrade the council chamber video system, honored two deceased residents, and approved the previous meeting's minutes.
